newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong drops petrol price to lowest in S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: Yukong drops petrol price to lowest in S.Korea.

text.p: South Korea's Yukong Ltd said on Thursday it had dropped its retail petrol price to 809 won per litre from 815 won -- the lowest level offered by the country's refiners.
A company spokesman said the action was taken to show appreciation to the refiner's customers.
Official pump prices offered by Hyundai Oil Refinery Co, Hanwha Energy Co Ltd and LG-Caltex Oil Corp currently stood at 815 won per litre, while that of Ssangyong Oil Refining Co was at 826.
Yukong has the largest share of the domestic petrol market at 37.5 percent, analysts said. It also has the biggest refining capacity of 810,000 barrels per day.
